selection.scope: same-seed two-final screening; no multi-training-seed significance or physical deployment claim

comparison.scope: one training seed; task failures retained; partial horizons cannot support an improvement claim

limitations: One training seed per arm; three evaluation reset seeds do not establish training-seed robustness.
Single-env 1x4096 changes trajectory and GAE boundaries versus four-env24; no one-variable effect against24 claimed.
RSS/PSS are three self-observed samples, not process peaks or proof of memory savings versus24.
KL early stop is minibatch-local; epoch count is not optimizer-step count.
All36 mean J contains fixed early-failure penalties; common-full paired J is reported separately.
CPP64 checks numerical parity only; these formal cases use the declared Python ORT physical backend.
Historical baseline metrics are read from saved reports; traces are SHA checked, not recomputed in this analysis.
Automatic model replacement is disabled; simulation qualification is not a hardware claim.
